wildshape.gui.button.alluvialFans.toolti: Cones of gravel and sand spreading out where steep valleys open onto flat land at the foot of mountains, mostly in dry climates
wildshape.gui.button.atolls.tooltip: Rings of coral reef far out in warm seas, with low sandy islets and a shallow lagoon inside
wildshape.gui.button.barrierIslands.tool: Long, thin islands of sand just off flat coasts, broken by inlets, with a calm, shallow lagoon behind them
wildshape.gui.button.blueHoles.tooltip: Deep, round, sheer-sided pits in warm, shallow seas
wildshape.gui.button.buttes.tooltip: Flat-topped towers of rock with sheer cliffs, from narrow buttes to broad, sometimes stepped mesas. They stand in badlands, on plateaus and on flat desert and savanna land
wildshape.gui.button.canyons.tooltip: Winding, branching dry canyons with walls stepped into ledges, cut into badlands and plateaus. With rock layers on, their walls show the bands of rock
wildshape.gui.button.caveMouths.tooltip: Cave entrances open in hillsides, cliffs and gorge walls rather than as holes in flat fields
wildshape.gui.button.climateSeedOffset.t: A seed offset used to randomise climate distribution
wildshape.gui.button.coastalIslands.tool: Islands standing a little way off the coast on the shallow shelf, some tied to the mainland by a sandbar
wildshape.gui.button.continentShape.tool: Controls how continent shapes are calculated. You may also need to adjust the transition points to ensure beaches etc still form.
wildshape.gui.button.coralReefs.tooltip: Reefs of living coral growing up almost to the surface off warm coasts
wildshape.gui.button.customBiomeFeatures: Use custom biome features in place of vanilla ones (such as trees)
wildshape.gui.button.deltas.tooltip: Where a big river meets the sea on a flat coast, it fans out into branching channels between marshy islands and sandbars
wildshape.gui.button.drumlins.tooltip: On cold lowlands, what old ice sheets left behind: swarms of smooth, oval hills all lying the same way, and long, low ridges of rubble
wildshape.gui.button.dunes.tooltip: Fields of sand dunes on the flat land of hot deserts, with long, wavy crests across the prevailing wind
wildshape.gui.button.erosionDecorator.to: Steep and high ground loses its soil: bare rock on cliffs, coarse dirt and loose gravel on slopes
wildshape.gui.button.fancyMountains.tool: Carries out extra processing on mountains to make them look even nicer. Can be disabled to improve performance slightly.
wildshape.gui.button.fjords.tooltip: On cold and rainy coasts the sea floods up the valleys between the mountains, in long, branching inlets between steep ridges
wildshape.gui.button.giantCaverns.toolti: Rare, huge chambers deep underground, with stone pillars and a lake on their floor
wildshape.gui.button.glacialValleys.tool: In cold mountains, valleys worn by old glaciers into U-shaped troughs with flat floors and steep walls, and round cirque bowls under the peaks holding small lakes that spill over in waterfalls
wildshape.gui.button.glacierCaves.toolti: Tunnels of blue ice leading into the mountainside from glacial valleys and cirques
wildshape.gui.button.headlands.tooltip: A ragged coastline: rocky points reaching out into the sea between sheltered bays and coves
wildshape.gui.button.islandArcs.tooltip: Curved chains of volcanic islands out in the open sea, with craters and dark volcanic rock
wildshape.gui.button.karst.tooltip: In warm, wet lands, limestone worn away by rain: clusters of steep tower hills, sinkholes, and cenotes, sinkholes open down to water
wildshape.gui.button.karstCaves.tooltip: Great chambers and passages under karst country, with potholes dropping into them and pools on their floors
wildshape.gui.button.largeOreVeins.toolt: Set whether large ore veins spawn
wildshape.gui.button.lavaTubes.tooltip: Long, round tunnels running downhill from volcanoes just under the ground, lined with basalt, with collapsed skylights
wildshape.gui.button.layerCaves.tooltip: Wide, low caves running level along the rock layers, so a cliff face shows their mouths in rows
wildshape.gui.button.naturalSnowDecorato: Removes snow from the terrain where it shouldn't naturally settle
wildshape.gui.button.oreCompatibleStoneO: Only use rocks that ores can generate in. When off, rocks such as tuff, calcite and other mods' decorative stones are layered too, and those hold no ores
wildshape.gui.button.peninsulas.tooltip: Long arms of land reaching out from the coast into the sea, narrowing and bending towards their tip
wildshape.gui.button.raisedWater.tooltip: Rivers, lakes and wetlands keep their water a few blocks below their banks, high in the hills as well as by the sea, instead of all cutting down to sea level
wildshape.gui.button.ridges.tooltip: Long ridges across the deep ocean floor, split by a rift valley where hydrothermal vents smoke with magma
wildshape.gui.button.riverBanks.tooltip: River and lake beds and banks that suit their setting: gravel and cobbles in the mountains, sand and clay in the lowlands, and mud in wetlands and deltas
wildshape.gui.button.riverIslands.toolti: Islands in lakes, and long islands splitting wide rivers into channels
wildshape.gui.button.riverSeedOffset.too: A seed offset used to randomise river distribution
wildshape.gui.button.rockShelters.toolti: Overhangs worn into the foot of cliffs in badlands and canyons, like the shelters of cliff dwellings
wildshape.gui.button.salt.tooltip: A random seed value for the structure.
wildshape.gui.button.saltFlats.tooltip: Dead flat, pale basins of salt crust on the low ground of hot, dry deserts, like dried up lake beds
wildshape.gui.button.sandWaves.tooltip: Rippled ridges of sand on the shallow sea floor, lined up with the currents
wildshape.gui.button.seaCaves.tooltip: Caves cut into sea cliffs at the waterline, flooded by the sea, and arches right through narrow headlands
wildshape.gui.button.seaCliffs.tooltip: Stretches of coast where the land ends in a sheer cliff over the sea, with a rocky shelf instead of a beach
wildshape.gui.button.seaFloorSediment.to: Sand in the shallows, and sand, gravel and clay further out, over the sea floor, rather than bare rock; the rock still shows on steep slopes
wildshape.gui.button.seaStacks.tooltip: Pillars of rock standing in the sea off the cliffs
wildshape.gui.button.seamounts.tooltip: Underwater mountains rising from the deep, some with flat tops worn off long ago
wildshape.gui.button.shelves.tooltip: A broad, shallow shelf off every coast, ending in a clear drop-off into the deep sea
wildshape.gui.button.skerries.tooltip: Swarms of small, bare rocky islets off cold coasts
wildshape.gui.button.smoothLayerDecorato: Modifies layer block levels (ie snow) to fit the terrain
wildshape.gui.button.spawnType.tooltip: Set whether spawn should be close to x=0,z=0 or the centre of the nearest continent
wildshape.gui.button.spits.tooltip: Narrow bars of sand curving out from the coast into the sea
wildshape.gui.button.springs.tooltip: Water welling out of small caves in hillsides and running down the slope
wildshape.gui.button.stoneErosion.toolti: Keeps the rock laid bare on steep slopes plain stone, so the layers only show in caves, ravines and deep cuts
wildshape.gui.button.strataDecorator.too: Fills the underground with bands of stone, granite, diorite, andesite and other mods' natural stones that show in cliffs, caves and ravines, like layers in a canyon wall. Replaces vanilla's scattered blobs of those rocks
wildshape.gui.button.structureEnabled.to: Whether this structure set generates at all
wildshape.gui.button.submarineCanyons.to: Deep, winding canyons cut into the shelf, running from near the coast out over the drop-off
wildshape.gui.button.terrainSeedOffset.t: A seed offset used to randomise terrain distribution
wildshape.gui.button.tors.tooltip: Outcrops of bare rock on hilltops: blocky stacks of rock slabs, with boulders strewn around them
wildshape.gui.button.trenches.tooltip: Long, narrow, curving chasms plunging far below the deep ocean floor
wildshape.gui.button.undergroundRivers.t: Long, winding tunnels deep under the land with a river flowing along their floor
Allow vanilla springs (lava source blocks) to generate
wildshape.gui.button.vanillaSprings.tool: Allow vanilla springs (water source blocks) to generate
wildshape.gui.button.volcanicSurface.too: Lava over magma in volcano craters, basalt, blackstone and tuff on their cones, and patches of old lava flows on the land around them
wildshape.gui.button.whaleFalls.tooltip: The bones of great whales lying on the deep sea floor
wildshape.gui.button.windingRivers.toolt: Rivers move off their straight courses onto the lowest ground nearby, winding around hills and along valleys rather than climbing over them or cutting gorges

wildshape.gui.performanceMods.category.g: Speeds up the game and saves memory
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.help: Mods that make Wildshape worlds faster to generate and play. Click one to open its page.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.light.gree: Every recommended performance mod available for this version is installed.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.light.oran: No mod that speeds up world generation is installed, so new land will generate slower than it could.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.light.red: None of the recommended performance mods are installed.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.light.yell: Some of the recommended performance mods are installed.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.allThe: Fixes memory leaks in Minecraft and many mods.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.c2me: Generates, loads and saves chunks on many threads at once: the biggest speed-up for exploring new land.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.c2meOp: An add-on for C2ME that moves parts of world generation onto the graphics card. It can't speed up Wildshape's worlds, which generate without it, only vanilla ones. Optional: it needs Java 25 and a graphics card with OpenCL, and doesn't work together with Noisium(ed), so install one or the other.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.lithiu: Speeds up ticking, mob AI, physics and parts of world generation, without changing how the game plays.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.modern: Cuts loading times and memory use.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.noisiu: Fills new chunks with blocks faster, without changing the terrain. Noisium itself is no longer updated; Noisiumed is its maintained fork.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.mod.sodium: Renders the world far faster, for smoother frame rates and longer view distances.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.standsIn: %s has no build for %s; %s does the same job there.
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.title: Performance Mods
wildshape.gui.performanceMods.viaConnect: %s has no %s build, but its Fabric build runs through Sinytra Connector, together with Forgified Fabric API.
